prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic extreme close-up of an adult woman outdoors in gentle snowfall. She has pale skin with visible natural texture, pores and light freckles, rosy cold-flushed cheeks and nose, blue-green eyes in razor-sharp focus, and loose windblown hair dusted with fresh snow. She wears a chunky coarse-knit brownish-gray wool scarf or high-collar sweater with visible fibers and snow accumulation. Use large out-of-focus snowflakes near lens, a soft blurred snowy background, and diffuse overcast winter light with soft catchlights and no harsh shadows. Shoot on an 85mm or 105mm lens at f/1.8-f/2.8 with shallow depth, cinematic fine-art winter grading, natural skin texture, and fine grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, CGI, 3D render, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed
